title: Cleared history still shows up in search
body:
### Brief summary

You can still look up your read history in the search bar even when you have turned on incognito or cleared out your history.

### Steps to reproduce

Example:
-I read an embarrassing comic that I want to hide
-I remove it from history (clear out all history, have incognito turned on, ect.)
-I search up one letter that existed in the comic's name
-The comic shows up

### Kotatsu version

4.0.4

### Android version

12

### Device

_No response_

### Acknowledgements

- [X] I have searched the existing issues and this is a new ticket, **NOT** a duplicate or related to another open issue.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
Clearing history ≠ clearing search history
Swipe to left or right search query to delete it from search history or go to *Options -> Settings -> History and cache* and click *Clear search history*
